title: SecureFlow
longDescription: SecureFlow is an ISO 27001-aligned document management system (Next.js, FastAPI, Supabase) with versioning, multi-step approvals, and classification-based RBAC. Secured with domain-locked Google OAuth and TOTP MFA enforced at the middleware, and containerized with Docker Compose behind IIS on Windows Server, with automated firewall changes and Active Directory sync via Ansible + WinRM.

title: Fundr Classic
shortDescription: A Windows XP Desktop as a Studio Website
longDescription: Fundr Classic is the main site of fundr. studio, built as a working Windows XP desktop: a boot screen picks between the classic desktop and a modern landing page, and every section of the studio opens as a draggable XP window. It ships from a single multi-page Vite build that also serves the studio's browser games and its serverless API routes (newsletter, briefs, PayPal), with a CRT hero plate composited at several widths so a phone never downloads the desktop artwork.

title: TD Scans
longDescription: TD Scans is the lab half of a Tutorials Dojo vulnerability-scanning course. A Node scanner audits a fixed registry of deliberately weak sites against the Mozilla HTTP Observatory model and commits the results as JSON, refreshed nightly by a GitHub Actions workflow that only pushes when the agreement suite passes. The frontend renders those reports and runs seven hands-on labs on top of them with no backend, no database, and no account.

title: Desku
shortDescription: A VA Workflow Organizer on the App Store
longDescription: Desku is a published iOS and Android app that gives Filipino virtual assistants one command center for clients, shifts, tasks, invoices, and income. It tracks shifts across client time zones with local reminders, generates invoice PDFs on device, and reports monthly earnings and overdue payments. Built with Expo and an on-device SQLite store, with subscriptions handled through RevenueCat.

title: iSkolar Academy
shortDescription: A Student Project Showcase and Funding Platform
longDescription: iSkolar Academy is a showcase, discovery, and funding platform for student work. Students publish projects that pass a working-MVP gate and an admin review before becoming publicly discoverable, while a separate grants track lets a thesis request funds from its starting stage with money moving on-platform. Sponsors and investors browse a uniform filterable card, keep private watchlists, and open consent-gated pitch vaults behind subscription tiers. Identity is delegated to iSkolar via federated SSO, so Academy holds no password store.

title: GabayTek
shortDescription: A Structured Course Platform Enhanced by an AI-Learning Assistant
longDescription: GabayTek is a cross-platform Electron + React desktop app with a bundled Flask backend. It uses dual auth (local JWT plus Supabase OAuth) with RBAC, and serves AI recommendation and learning-style assessment endpoints powered by Gemini 2.5 Pro. Build and release are fully automated: PyInstaller backend packaging, electron-builder multi-OS installers, and electron-updater auto-updates.

title: Makati Heritage Web Portal
shortDescription: A Static Website detailing Makati City
longDescription: The web portal is a project for the ISDNB in the University of Makati. It details all the heritage sites in Makati City.

title: Cove
shortDescription: An Offline-First Task and Agenda Manager for Android
longDescription: Cove is a single-user Flutter app for Android with no account, no backend, and no telemetry: tasks, schedules, recurrences, and categories live in a local Drift database on the phone. A typed line is parsed into area, priority, and schedule by Quick Add, then shown through four lenses (Agenda, Up Next, Calendar, Areas) that are mirrored by three tap-to-complete home-screen widgets. Reminders fire from on-device notifications, completing tasks earns XP toward cosmetic-only unlocks, and Google Calendar sync is optional and off by default.
